title.zh: 账号安全、联系隐私与资料问答更新
title.en: Account security, contact privacy and source-based Q&A

added.zh: 新增可自行设置的唯一用户号，支持用户号、已验证邮箱及手机号查找。
added.en: Choose a unique user number and find people by number, verified email or verified phone.

added.zh: 增加各查找方式的隐私开关，以及手机号验证、换绑和解绑流程。
added.en: Control each discovery method and verify, replace or unlink a phone number.

added.zh: 新增版本与更新记录页面，网站、更新日志和启动器使用统一版本信息。
added.en: View version history with consistent release information across the website, changelog and launcher.

added.zh: 工作台增加下一步引导、默认展开的操作说明，以及账号安全与隐私快捷入口。
added.en: The dashboard now highlights your next step, opens its instructions and provides shortcuts to account security and privacy.

fixed.zh: 关闭查找或拉黑后，直接指定用户 ID 也不能绕过好友申请限制；管理和审核账号不可搜索或添加。
fixed.en: Direct user IDs cannot bypass discovery or block settings. Administrative and review accounts cannot be discovered or added.

fixed.zh: 修复切换联系人分类时旧搜索结果覆盖列表，以及拉黑后残留私聊内容的问题。
fixed.en: Prevent stale search results from replacing contact lists and clear the active conversation after blocking.

fixed.zh: 合并重复短信配置，增加生产配置解析检查。
fixed.en: Merge duplicate SMS configuration and validate the production configuration file.

fixed.zh: 拒绝重复 JSON 字段、多段 JSON 和多个身份凭据，避免同一请求被不同层以不同方式解释。
fixed.en: Reject duplicate JSON fields, trailing JSON payloads and multiple authorization credentials to avoid ambiguous request parsing.

fixed.zh: 修复不存在的登录用户名触发 500 错误的问题，统一返回普通认证失败。
fixed.en: Fix unknown login names causing a 500 error; return a normal authentication failure instead.

fixed.zh: 资料问答的 AI 错误在问答区单独显示，保留问题和选择，提供用量与配置入口；重新加载资料不会重发模型请求。调整 Kimi K3 思考力度、生成预算和等待时限，区分超时、连接中断及输出截断。
fixed.en: Show Q&A model errors beside the question, preserving selections and linking to usage and settings. Reloading sources never resends a model request. Tune Kimi K3 reasoning, output budget and generation deadlines, and distinguish timeout, connection and truncation failures.

improved.zh: 黑名单支持查找、搜索结果直接拉黑、解除确认和完成反馈。
improved.en: Search the blocklist, block from search results and confirm unblocking with clear feedback.

improved.zh: 补充号码唯一性、并发、隐私隔离和角色变更的回归测试；更新 DOMPurify。
improved.en: Add regression coverage for uniqueness, concurrency, privacy and role changes; update DOMPurify.

improved.zh: 后续启动器按版本命名，下载地址与镜像标签自动生成，不再覆盖同名旧版本。
improved.en: Generate versioned launcher names, download URLs and image tags for future releases.

improved.zh: 增加跨 IP、跨登录方式的账号级密码保护：15 分钟内连续失败 8 次，限制登录 5 分钟；限制期间重试不延长等待。
improved.en: Add account-level password protection across IPs and login aliases: eight failures within 15 minutes trigger a five-minute cooldown, which retries do not extend.

improved.zh: 入门进度只读取本人实际保存的数据，权限变更和切换账号后重新核验；查询找到首条记录就停止，不再统计全部历史。
improved.en: Onboarding reflects only your saved work and rechecks after account or permission changes. Progress queries stop at the first matching record instead of counting all history.

improved.zh: 资料问答取消 8 份数量限制，支持当前页全选、跨页累加和清空；未选资料时悬停发送按钮显示提示。长资料按问题分配片段容量，并继续逐份校验访问权限。
improved.en: Remove the eight-source Q&A limit. Select the current page, accumulate sources across pages or clear them; hovering over the send button explains when a source is required. Long sources share a passage budget while access is checked individually.

improved.zh: 增加桌面本地版本同步流程：更新前加密备份并校验，保留账号与资料，更新后检查 EXE、应用镜像及接口。
improved.en: Add local desktop synchronization with verified encrypted backups, preserved accounts and data, and launcher, image and endpoint checks.

notes.zh: 0.11 为公开测试版，更新包含 Windows 启动器、配套运行文件和变化说明。
notes.en: 0.11 is a public test release with a Windows launcher, matching runtime files and change notes.

notes.zh: 短信服务未配置时，手机号验证和查找不可用；不将未验证号码视为已绑定。
notes.en: Phone verification and discovery remain unavailable until SMS is configured; unverified numbers are never treated as bound.

notes.zh: 更新前请备份数据。本版本包含数据库迁移，不支持直接降级数据库。
notes.en: Back up before updating. This version includes a database migration; direct database downgrades are unsupported.

added.zh: 提供 Windows 启动器，集成笔记、词汇学习、个人 AI、群组交流与代码可视化。
added.en: A Windows launcher for notes, vocabulary, personal AI, group collaboration and code visualization.

fixed.zh: 历史修订 2 修复学习中心断线恢复和更新后仍显示旧页面的问题。
fixed.en: Historical revision 2 fixed learning-workspace connection recovery and stale pages after updates.

notes.zh: 保留历史 0.1 下载。后续补丁使用独立版本号，不再以“修订”覆盖发布文件。
notes.en: Historical 0.1 downloads remain available. Future patches use separate versions instead of replacing revision assets.
